Rayen,

Okay, jokes aside for one tiny second: thanks for being the kind of friend who makes random days funnier. Even when you're being unbelievably annoying (a talent, honestly), I'm glad you're around. This game is basically a collection of nonsense wearing a fake serious hat, but the real message is simple: I appreciate you, bro. Never let this compliment affect your ego.

— your equally questionable bestie
